zero_set_cylinder_theorem.proof: A zero of a regular finite-valued product makes one unary or pairwise factor zero, hence forces the whole cylinder obtained by varying the other coordinates to vanish. In a nontrivial prime-order group, changing one free coordinate changes the sum, so Z_T contains no unary or pairwise cylinder.

translation_rank_theorem.kappa: x+w*y with a pole of order three at O
translation_rank_theorem.proof: For distinct P_i, the translate Q -> kappa(P_i+Q)-kappa(T) has its unique order-three pole at Q=-P_i. At that pole no other translate has a pole, so every finite linear relation has zero coefficient. The translates are linearly independent.
translation_rank_theorem.scope: This closes uniform finite separated-rank identities in the function field. It is not a lower bound for arbitrary small arithmetic circuits that generate high rank implicitly.
